item.title: Villager News 1.0 Add-On
item.creator: Oreville Studios
item.description:
BREAKING NEWS! Villager News is live in an official Oreville Studios x Element Animation collaboration! Bring your Villagers to life today!
- 2,000+ voiced reactions!
- Reactive dialogue to mobs, blocks, player actions and more!
- Expressive animations & lip sync!
- Player reputation & gossip systems!
- Special characters & unique trades!

faqEntries.heading: Is the Villager News an official collaboration with Element Animation?
faqEntries.content: Yes! The Villager News Add-On is an official collaboration between Oreville Studios and Element Animation, bringing the world, characters and humour of Villager News in-game.

faqEntries.heading: Is Villager News compatible with Actions & Stuff?
faqEntries.content: Yes! Villager News is fully compatible with Actions & Stuff, but can also be enjoyed on its own.

faqEntries.heading: How do I make Villagers react?
faqEntries.content: Just play normally and experiment around them! Villagers can react to player actions, mobs, blocks, trading, damage, world events and much more. Check the Triggers & Reactions Guide if you want to hunt for specific reactions.

faqEntries.heading: How does Player Reputation work?
faqEntries.content: Villagers remember how you treat them. Trading and curing improves your reputation, while hurting or killing Villagers lowers it. Villagers can also gossip about you, spreading your reputation to others.

faqEntries.heading: Where do I find the special Villager News characters?
faqEntries.content: Special Villager News characters can only spawn in Villages located at least 1,000 blocks away from world spawn. Explore further out to find them, with each character offering their own dialogue and unique trades.

faqEntries.heading: Do Baby Villagers have dialogue too?
faqEntries.content: Yes! Baby Villagers have their own reactions and animations.

howToEntries.content: Villager News brings Villagers to life with reactive dialogue, conversations, animations, reputation and plenty of hidden reactions to discover.
Play normally and experiment! Villagers react to mobs, blocks, trading, damage, player actions, world events and much more. Try doing different things around them and see what they have to say.
Explore Villages to find special Villager News characters. One of each can spawn in your world, with their own personality, dialogue and unique trades.
Treat Villagers carefully! They remember how you behave. Trading and curing improves your reputation, while hurting Villagers lowers it, and they may gossip about you with others.
Customise your experience from the Villager News Handbook in-game. Change Villager texture style, chattiness, rare voice lines, subtitles and toggle to the legacy baby villagers whenever you like.
Keep experimenting. Some reactions are much harder to discover than others. Browse the Triggers & Reactions Guide in-game if you want to see everything Villagers can react to.
